verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
When the heaven bursts asunder,
And gives ear to her Lord — and this is incumbent upon her —
And when the earth is spread out,
And casts out all that is in her, and becomes empty;
And gives ear to her Lord — and this is incumbent upon her —

verses.ar: یٰۤاَیُّہَا الۡاِنۡسَانُ اِنَّکَ کَادِحٌ اِلٰی رَبِّکَ کَدۡحًا فَمُلٰقِیۡہِ ۚ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: Thou, O man, art verily labouring towards thy Lord, a hard labouring; then thou art going to meet Him.
w: then thou art going to meet Him

verses.en: Then as for him who is given his book of record in his right hand,
He will soon have an easy reckoning,
And he will return to his household, rejoicing.

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا مَنۡ اُوۡتِیَ کِتٰبَہٗ وَرَآءَ ظَہۡرِہٖ ﴿ۙ۱۱﴾
verses.en: But as for him who will have his book of record given to him behind his back,
He will soon call for destruction,
And he will burn in a blazing Fire.
Verily, before this he lived joyfully among his family.
He indeed thought that he would never return to God.

verses.ar: بَلٰۤی ۚۛ اِنَّ رَبَّہٗ کَانَ بِہٖ بَصِیۡرًا ﴿ؕ۱۶﴾
verses.en: Yea! surely, his Lord sees him full well.
But nay! I call to witness the evening twilight,
And the night and all that it envelops,
And the moon when it becomes full,
That you shall assuredly pass on from one stage to another.
w: that you shall assuredly pass on

verses.en: So what is the matter with them that they believe not,

verses.ar: وَاِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَیۡہِمُ الۡقُرۡاٰنُ لَا یَسۡجُدُوۡنَ ﴿ؕٛ۲۲﴾
verses.en: And when the Qur’an is recited unto them, they do not bow down in submission;
On the contrary, those who disbelieve reject it.
And Allah knows best what they keep hidden in their hearts.
So give them tidings of a painful punishment.
w: so give them tidings of a

verses.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَہُمۡ اَجۡرٌ غَیۡرُ مَمۡنُوۡنٍ ﴿٪۲۶﴾
verses.en: But as to those who believe and do good works, theirs is an unending reward.
